portion_doctrine: Segments 11-19 are 95% transcript boilerplate + YouTube tutorial walkthrough content. Real operative content is thin and scattered across multiple unrelated tutorial domains (SaaS builders, website automation, brand identity creation, e-commerce dropshipping, TikTok content automation, AI agent orchestration). The portion is primarily instructional video transcripts with timestamps, UI navigation steps, and repetitive explanations. Minimal strategic doctrine or reusable methodology. Value lies only in specific tool integrations and automation patterns, not in founding principles or decision frameworks.
operating_rules: One-shot design beats iteration loops - aim for 90-95% on first pass, avoid endless redesign cycles (Gemini site framework)
Draft-mode publishing mandatory for new TikTok accounts (<30 days old) to avoid silent shadow ban - direct publish = bot risk signal
Warmup protocol for fresh TikTok accounts: Days 1-7 scroll/like/follow only; Days 8-14 post 1 draft/day via device (2-4hrs delay); Days 15-30 ramp to 2-3 drafts/day; Day 30+ full cadence
Pinterest-sourced images beat AI-generated for authentic niches (fitness, fashion, food, travel) by 2.3x engagement; reserve AI gen for anime/RPG/abstract only
Hermes cron jobs skip LLM execution when upstream data hasn't changed (pre-check pattern) - free processing for unchanged niche data
SaaS build-to-market speed: no-code (Lovable) launches in hours; manual coding in weeks; prioritize first deployment over perfection
Cold email as lead gen beats paid ads and content building for solopreneurs - 1 email campaign to 100s of businesses on autopilot
Niche targeting for solopreneur automation: go after AI-clueless businesses (HVAC, plumbers, roofers) NOT tech-savvy e-commerce; knowledge gap = pricing power
Personal brand + authenticity required for influencer outreach and marketing - faked stories get caught, damage credibility forever
Hook generation should bias against clickbait patterns (You won't believe...); calibrate against winning hooks; reusing exact phrasing triggers algorithm penalty
Branding as differentiation: when products are identical, brand positioning (quality/speed/mission) is the only moat
Budget-conscious dropshipping: <$1 spend possible (free trial Shopify + $1 AutoDS + free domain year) if you handle manual fulfillment or use auto-fulfillment via AutoDS
No passive income day 1 - all automation requires upfront work (influencer outreach, content creation, system setup) before reaching passive revenue
Email sequences effectiveness: 5+ touches minimum for response; first email alone gets <50% response rate; progressive value builds relationship before ask
prompts: Design a [niche] website using [reference images]. Use [specific stylistic guidelines]. Include these sections: [hook], [value proposition details], [proof], [CTA]. Format for conversion, not aesthetics.
Generate TikTok hooks for [niche]. Constraints: <60 characters, curiosity gap not clickbait, 3 archetypes (contrarian/listicle/transformation). Score each against winning hooks. Return top 3.
Route image sources per slide: [niche] + [hook] given. Pinterest for (fitness/fashion/food/travel/aesthetic). AI gen for (anime/RPG/abstract). Mixed: cover AI, body Pinterest.

Create a complete SaaS app for [use case] with AI integration. Prompt must include: feature list, UI structure, backend database setup (Supabase), AI tool selection (free with API), all without coding.
Generate a full brand identity for [company name]: strategy document, color palette, logo (animated + BW), icons (animated), photography guidelines, video sample. Output as design system JSON.

Build TikTok slideshow post: hook, 8 slide compositions, caption, hashtags. Route images per slot (Pinterest vs AI gen). Composite 1080x1920 slides. Schedule as draft (device publish for <30d accounts).
Set up Hermes cron pipeline for [account/niche]. Chain: [skill1] → [skill2] → [skill3]. Each stage receives context from prior. Skip LLM if upstream data unchanged.
Create cold email sequence for [business type] targeting [niche]. Value prop: [system name]. Highlight knowledge gap. A/B test 4 systems against different niches, report winner.
Dropshipping store setup: niche selection (must have passion + large market), branding (mission/values alignment), product sourcing (AutoDS trending), marketing (influencer + content + email list).
Design influencer outreach: micro-influencers (<5K followers) respond best. Ego-feed + revenue share offer. Expect 10-15% response rate. Numbers game: contact 100 to get 10-15 commitments.
gates: Before shipping any design: does it convert viewers to buyers, not just look pretty? (Gemini framework)
Before TikTok publish: is account >30 days old OR is being published from real device in draft mode? (shadow ban prevention)
Before influencer reach out: verify content alignment + feed quality, not follower count alone (authentic niche match > vanity metrics)
Before SaaS launch: does design load from computer (not AI browser only) with dependencies installed? (Black screen of death avoidance)
Before hook deploy: scores ≤60 chars, archetype pattern diverse, no clickbait patterns, top 3 score >= 7? (quality gate)
Before niche commit: do you have authentic passion + knowledge authority? Does market size justify time investment? (sustainability gate)
Before email campaign: have you tested against competing systems first? Do results show 1 clear winner before going all-in? (de-risking)
Before influencer payment: verbal confirm their account age, engagement rate, audience demo match niche? (fraud prevention)
content_ideas: How to launch a no-code SaaS in 2 hours using Lovable + Gemini 3.0 (with deployment to Vercel)
TikTok slideshow algorithm hack: why drafts + device-publish beats direct API on new accounts
Hermes Agent for solo content creators: automation pipeline (30 accounts, 1 post/day, no queue infrastructure)
Why Pinterest beats AI image generation for fitness/fashion by 2.3x engagement and how to route per-niche
The solopreneur's trifecta: personal computer (leverage) + internet (access) + AI (digital labor) = 1-person billion-dollar company possible
Cold email beats content for B2B lead gen: why 1 email to 100 businesses scales better than 1 post to 10K followers
Niche targeting for AI automation: sell to HVAC not SaaS shops (knowledge gap = pricing power)
Brand identity automation: 1 reference image + 1 company description = full logo/palette/icons/video system via CreateNodes
Dropshipping under $1: free Shopify trial + $1 AutoDS + free domain = launch test without budget
5 touches before 50% response: why email sequences outperform single-email outreach
Influencer micro-niche strategy: <5K followers respond better than mega-influencers for revenue share partnerships
contradictions: No-code tools promise 'automation' but require heavy upfront manual work (influencer sourcing, content direction, system design) before any passive revenue
SaaS speed advantage only if you trust AI design first-pass; iteration loops with Claude/Gemini can extend timelines if you're perfectionist (tension between speed and quality)
Cold email scales to 100s of businesses, but so does content; cold email is leverage IF you find winning system quickly, but content builds moat long-term (short-term ROI vs compound growth)
Niche targeting (HVAC shops) is easier to sell to but smaller TAM; generalist agencies (any client) harder to win but bigger market (classic niche vs scale tension)
Passive income messaging of dropshipping/automation vs reality of heavy work upfront (messaging lie vs operational truth)
Draft-mode TikTok safety rule contradicts algorithm desire for fast publish velocity (shadow ban prevention vs engagement consistency)
weird_gold: Postiz Cloud vs self-hosted Postiz: cloud won 30 req/hr cap limit, but self-hosted cost hidden in 5 hrs/week debugging (opportunity cost math not always obvious)
Hermes pre-check hash pattern: skip LLM entirely on repeat cycles if no data changed (free processing, but requires discipline to implement)
iPhone farm + draft mode: real device publishes from real IP to defeat TikTok bot detection (labor arbitrage: humans solve what automation can't fool)
Pinterest hammer-best fitness but AI gen fails on transformation slides specifically (perceptual uncanny valley learning, not general image gen failure)
Hook archetype performance curves: contrarian/listicle/transformation have different decay rates per niche (Fitness=listicle wins, RPG=contrarian wins) - not niche-agnostic
Micro-influencer hunger: <5K followers WANT revenue share because they're climbing, NOT because content is worse (motivation psychology, not quality gate)
Copywriting in non-English: Lovable/Gemini respond well to Hindi prompt-craft (chat GPT also translates spec mid-task if you don't force English) - localization unspoken
API key bloat: Tavily + OpenAI + Postiz + Supabase + Google Cloud all in one Hermes session = 5+ env vars, but pre-check pattern lets you skip most on unchanged data (setup tax amortizes fast)
Brand niche selection tie to personal conviction: stated rule 'be passionate' but real rule is 'market size must be > personal burnout threshold' (motivation engineering as risk mitigation)
